name: A-League Men
headline: A-League Men Finals & Championship Odds

rules.summary: 12 clubs (Auckland FC and Wellington Phoenix from New Zealand), 26 games each over 28 matchweeks: home and away against everyone plus four third meetings. 3 points a win, 1 a draw. Clubs level on points are separated by goal difference, goals scored, wins, head-to-head points, head-to-head goal difference, fewest Fair Play points, away goal difference, away goals per away game, home goal difference, home goals per home game, then a coin toss or drawing of lots. The best record wins the Premiers Plate. The top six reach the Finals Series: 3rd hosts 6th and 4th hosts 5th in single-match Elimination Finals; 1st plays the lower-ranked Elimination Final winner and 2nd the higher-ranked one in two-legged Semi-Finals on aggregate (no away goals; 1st and 2nd choose which leg to host, and have taken the second leg); the Grand Final is one match hosted by the higher-placed finalist. A finals match or tie level after normal time goes to extra time, then penalties. The Grand Final winners are the Champions. The 2026-27 competition rules have not been published yet, so these are the 2025-26 rules; the 2026-27 fixture keeps 12 clubs, 26 games each and a Grand Final on 3-6 June 2027.

notes: Finals: the top six qualify. 3rd hosts 6th and 4th hosts 5th in Elimination Finals; 1st and 2nd then play the lower- and higher-ranked winners over two legs, with the second leg at 1st's and 2nd's grounds, and the higher-placed finalist hosts the Grand Final. Every level finals match or tie goes to extra time, then penalties.
The Fair Play tiebreaker (cards) is not in the data; ESPN's published order, which matches aleagues.com.au, is used whenever its records agree with the results.
These are the 2025-26 competition rules; the A-Leagues have not yet published 2026-27's.

Backtested on 2024-25 and 2025-26: week-ahead match predictions score 0.232 (ranked probability score) against 0.235 for home/draw/away base rates (0.223 v 0.236 in 2024-25, 0.242 v 0.234 in 2025-26). Finals, top-two, premiership and title odds at a quarter, half and three quarters of each season scored better with more strength drift than Europe's 0.2 (mean Brier 0.0848 at 0.3 against 0.0865), so the A-League uses 0.3.
